shared.production_top_k_rule: choose the smallest depth retaining at least 90% of Recall@50 unless calibration localization within 100m regresses by more than 1 point versus the next depth

baseline.license_status: MIT checkpoint integration already cleared in docs/licenses.md

candidates.license_status: evaluation-only pending checkpoint and combined-application GPL compatibility review
same cleared MegaLoc artifact as baseline

selection.rule: require >=5 point Recall@10 or Recall@20 gain, positive paired-bootstrap evidence, and no unexplained major-stratum regression; freeze production only from production_eligible configurations; if none clears the gate, freeze the best justified eligible configuration without claiming material improvement

confidence.no_feasible_policy: report impossibility and use threshold 1.0 as a fail-closed abstention default

final_test.allowed_after: frozen runtime configuration is written and hashed
